scope: Local Windows PostgreSQL 17.11 only; 60 synthetic riders. Each measured call uses a fresh backend after shared-buffer warmup and includes PL/pgSQL preparation; not a steady-state production benchmark or capacity test.

recovery.method: pg_dump custom archive -> independent local database -> row counts, function hashes, policy/index counts equal

limitations: Microbenchmarks include noise and different cache/WAL states; do not extrapolate percentages to production.
Whole production backups, storage, managed Auth, Edge deployment versions and secrets were not restored.
